Parker
Lucite and Metal Fountain Pen
Mid-Century Modern, Circa 1940s-1950s
This vintage Parker "51" fountain pen features the model's signature streamlined silhouette, introduced originally in 1941 to revolutionize writing instruments. The design highlights a tapered black barrel, an integrated hooded nib assembly, and a brushed metal lustraloy-style slip-on cap with an arrow clip. It comes housed in its vintage clamshell presentation box lined with satin and fitted card stock.
Parker "51" aerodynamic design with hooded nib and streamlined profile
Black resin/lucite barrel with brushed metal cap and silver-tone arrow pocket clip
Marked "51" and "Parker" on inner presentation case insert

Vintage condition with age-appropriate cosmetic wear. Barrel and hood show light surface micro-scratching consistent with handling and use. Cap retains its clip firmly and seats securely. Box exterior exhibits scuffs, edge wear, and surface rubbing; interior card shows vintage handwriting in ink across the lower bezel. Untested for ink filling and writing functionality.

Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era

This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Scott's Mineral Box Industries
Vintage Rocks and Minerals Specimen Collection Set
24 Labeled Specimens with Display Box
A classic mid-century educational geology collection produced by Scott's Mineral Box Industries of Custer, South Dakota. Dating to the 1950s to 1960s, these boxed study sets were distributed to rockhounds, students, and tourists visiting the Black Hills. Each natural geological specimen is mounted and identified on a printed compartmentalized tray, illustrating key ore, mineral, and rock classifications from North American deposits.
Includes 24 individually labeled specimens including Gold Ore, Copper Ore, Rose Quartz, Muscovite, Uranium Ore, and Petrified Wood
Accompanied by an additional natural clear quartz crystal point
Housed in the original faux-tooled leatherette textured cardboard box with matching lid
Measures approximately 8.6 inches long by 5.6 inches wide by 1 inch deep
Condition:
Box lid and base remain structurally sound with light corner and edge wear consistent with age. Printed tray is clean and legible with all 24 labeled specimens intact and firmly attached. Loose quartz crystal point is complete with natural terminations and surface inclusions.

description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot of 2
Amethyst Quartz Cluster & Cut Base Green Fluorite
2 Pieces
This lot of two natural geological specimens features an amethyst quartz crystal geode cluster and a substantial rough green fluorite display piece with a sawn flat base. The amethyst specimen exhibits lavender to violet crystalline points resting atop a layered agate and basalt matrix band. The companion green fluorite specimen displays pale seafoam to emerald-green translucent crystalline mass with natural rough cleavage and mineral veining, cut flat on the bottom and back for upright shelf or tabletop display.
Includes two distinct natural mineral display specimens
Amethyst cluster features defined crystalline druzy terminations and agate banding
Green fluorite specimen features cut flat base and back for stable freestanding display
Suitable for mineral collectors, lapidary display, or natural interior accents

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight via Fedex Ground or Home Delivery. We do not use Express or overnight shipping. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight. These are Fedex rules, not ours. We try to ship items the day after receiving payment. Payments must be received by 7:00 am to be shipped that day. After 7:00 am the item(s) will ship the following day. We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days.
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
We put ADULT SIGNATURE REQUIRED on your package delivery if your order totals more than $100.00 excluding, tax, handling and shipping. Items under the value of $100.00 will NOT be receiving the signature option. This is to help prevent porch theft and to minimize lost packages. We are doing this for you, the buyer. This requirement is in your best interest and at no cost to you. We are paying for this surcharge and it is our way of giving back to you to ensure you receive your item(s).
If you would prefer not to have the signature requirement, please contact us by opening a service ticket to let us know that you would not prefer it
. If you place your item on hold for pickup at any Fedex location that has Adult Signature Required, you will be required to show ID but your address on the ID must match the ship to address on the label.
Regarding lost or delayed packages: If a package has been or is being delayed (non-movement on the tracking number after 2-4 days), please notify us by opening a customer service ticket for your shipped item. We will, in turn, file a claim on our behalf with Fedex for your package. This will trigger a search for your package, if found by Fedex, your package will start moving again. If not found, Fedex will pay the claim. When Fedex marks the claim as paid in their system, we will then issue your refund, not before, no exceptions. This process can take 2-4 weeks to resolve. We check on claim statuses Monday - Friday and will issue your refund accordingly.
REMINDER:
If you place your item on hold for pickup at a Fedex location, you have 7 days (including weekends) to pick up your package. Failure to pick up your package at the hold location results in the package being returned to us. You will then have to pay new shipping charges if you want your item re-shipped. If not, the item is then considered a donation and there will be no refunds issued under any circumstances.
Fedex does not deliver to PO Boxes
. You must provide a physical street address. If you have a PO Box setup on your account that you use, you may modify your SHIP TO ADDRESS when submitting your payment.
WE DO NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS
. We strongly urge users to estimate shipping before bidding. We do not lower or alter FedEx rates and will not cancel orders for shipping cost reasons.

description:
Raw Mineral & Rock Specimen Lot
Natural Geological Collection
5 Pieces
This assorted collection of five unpolished geological rock and mineral specimens features diverse textures, crystal formations, and mineral compositions. Ranging from crystalline aggregates to metamorphic and mineralized ore samples, this lot is well suited for educational study, earth science reference, or natural decorative display.
Items Included:
Large matrix plate featuring microcrystalline druzy pockets and earthy mineral tones
Coarse-grained crystalline rock specimen with quartz and feldspar matrix
Orange blocky cleavage specimen exhibiting distinct crystal planes
Elongated foliated metamorphic stone with visible mineral layering
Dense mineral ore rock with reddish-brown oxidation and dark metallic tones
Condition:
All five specimens are in natural, rough raw condition as collected. Surfaces exhibit natural fractures, irregular cleavage edges, natural sediment, and mineral veining. Free of artificial polishing or tumbling.

TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.
We describe each item to the best of our ability; however, we are
NOT

All gemstones are tested on a Presidium Gemstone Tester. This equipment CANNOT determine between natural, lab created and synthetic gemstones. There are no returns accepted for lab created or synthetic gemstones.
Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. TERMINOLOGY USED IN OUR LISTINGS:

Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.

The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.

description:
Viva Bohemia
Karlovy Vary Spa Cup Mineral Water Sipper
Porcelain, Cobalt Blue, Vintage
Traditional Czech spa drinking cup (lazensky poharek) designed for sipping thermal mineral waters in the historic spa town of Karlovy Vary (Carlsbad). Featuring an ergonomic hollow handle that functions as an integrated drinking straw, this piece showcases a rich cobalt blue glaze accented with delicate floral sprays, gilded accents, and geometric border patterning.
Integrated drinking spout extending through the handle for thermal spring waters
Deep cobalt blue porcelain with multi-colored floral bouquet and script Karlovy Vary lettering
Fully marked on underside with circular fountain logo reading Karlsbad Karlovy Vary Carlsbad Original Viva Bohemia
Measures approximately 5 inches by 5 inches
Condition:
Decoration fully intact with crisp script and vibrant floral details. Free of chips, cracks, crazing, or fleabites along the rim, base, and spout opening. Glossy glaze finish preserved throughout with only minor shelf wear to the unglazed foot pads.

Each piece boasts distinct mineral textures, vibrant color bands, and naturally polished surfaces visible from all angles, offering an engaging visual experience. Perfect for display in a home, office, or as educational decor, these stones are sure to draw interest for their natural artistry and one-of-a-kind attributes. Designed for outdoor use, it incorporates a slotted metal windcap and a threaded base.
Carved briar bowl with relief stag motif and Berchtesgaden banner
Stamped "BRUYERE M&T GARANTIE" and "Allwetter 63460" on shank
Hinged vented metal windcap with attached cord and bead accents
Detachable dark foot base and angled composite and metal stem
Condition:
Briar shows rich patina and minor surface handling wear. Metal windcap exhibits age-appropriate oxidation and tarnishing. Hinged lid and stem components fit securely. Bowl interior shows signs of previous smoking.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland

This two-piece mineral specimen lot features an authentic amethyst geode cluster slab and an amethyst core cylinder. The primary display plate showcases a rich purple crystal druzy cavity framed by a polished blue-grey agate banding border with an intact natural matrix base. Accompanying the geode plate is a solid drilled core cylinder terminating in natural crystalline points with distinct zoning and phantom inclusions.
Items Included:
Amethyst Geode Cluster Slab: Displays deep violet terminations bordered by polished chalcedony agate; measures approximately 6.5 x 5.5 inches with a thickness of roughly 2.25 inches
Amethyst Core Cylinder: Features polished cylindrical sides and rough terminated top; measures approximately 3.5 inches in height and 37.4 mm (1.47 inches) in diameter

Condition:

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
